paragraphs.en: Cross-organizational collaboration is widely regarded as a key promise of SysML-based Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), yet practitioners still face persistent challenges when exchanging and integrating system models. In parallel, Large Language Models (LLMs) raise expectations for AI-assisted model understanding and integration, while reliability and required human oversight continue to pose challenges. This paper reports the results of an online questionnaire survey with 29 MBSE stakeholders involved in cross-organizational collaboration. Respondents rated eight predefined integration challenge categories and six AI-supported task types on five-point Likert scales. The results indicate that stakeholders perceive model integration as a multi-dimensional alignment problem across semantics, behavior, traceability, and exchange interoperability. These perceptions vary by organizational role and frequency of integration involvement. AI is rated highly useful for analysis tasks such as semantic structure analysis and inconsistency detection, and respondents predominantly prefer human-in-the-loop use with mandatory verification. These findings motivate AI support that enhances, rather than replaces, engineering responsibility in SysML-based integration.
paragraphs.zh: 跨组织协作被广泛视为基于SysML的模型驱动系统工程（MBSE）的关键优势之一，但从业者在进行系统模型交换与集成时仍面临持续的挑战。 与此同时，大语言模型（LLM）提升了人们对AI辅助模型理解与集成的期待，但其可靠性和所需的人工监督仍然构成挑战。 本文报告了一项在线问卷调查的结果，该调查涉及29位参与跨组织协作的MBSE利益相关者。 受访者使用五点李克特量表对八个预定义集成挑战类别和六种AI支持任务类型进行了评分。 结果表明，利益相关者认为模型集成是一个涉及语义、行为、可追溯性和交换互操作性的多维度对齐问题。 这些认知因组织角色以及参与集成的频率而有所不同。 受访者认为AI在语义结构分析和不一致性检测等分析任务中非常有用，并普遍偏好采用“人在回路”的使用方式，同时要求强制验证。 这些发现表明，AI支持应增强而非取代基于SysML的集成过程中的工程责任。

paragraphs.en: Cross-organizational collaboration in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) is becoming increasingly important, yet the exchange and integration of SysML-based models across company and tool boundaries remains a challenge due to heterogeneous modeling methods, tool ecosystems, and domain-specific practices among partners [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在基于模型的系统工程（MBSE）中，跨组织协作正变得日益重要。然而，由于合作伙伴之间建模方法、工具生态系统和领域特定实践存在异质性，跨公司和工具边界的 SysML 模型交换与集成仍然是一项挑战 [1, 2, 3]。

paragraphs.en: In this context, System Modeling Language v2 (SysML v2) provides new technical capabilities for collaborative MBSE through formally defined semantics, semantic consistency between textual and graphical representations, and standardized REST API [ 4 , 5 ] . In parallel, recent work explores Large Language Models (LLMs)-based AI-assistance capabilities, such as model generation, model comprehension, and semantic conflict detection [ 6 ] . However, the inherent uncertainty and limited explainability of LLM outputs pose challenges to their adoption in rigorous engineering practice [ 7 , 8 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在此背景下，系统建模语言 v2（SysML v2）通过正式定义的语义、文本与图形表示之间的语义一致性以及标准化的 REST API，为协作式 MBSE 提供了新的技术能力 [ 4 , 5 ] 。 与此同时，近期的研究探索了基于大语言模型（LLM）的人工智能辅助能力，例如模型生成、模型理解和语义冲突检测 [ 6 ] 。 然而，LLM 输出的固有不确定性和有限的可解释性，给其在严谨的工程实践中的应用带来了挑战 [ 7 , 8 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Empirical studies on the introduction of Systems Engineering in industrial contexts have identified persistent organizational, methodological, and tooling-related barriers that hinder effective adoption [ 9 ] . Furthermore, recent research on collaborative MBSE and model integration has made progress through survey-based investigations of MBSE stakeholders perspectives alongside literature-based and conceptual analyses [ 10 , 1 ] . However, the perspectives of MBSE practitioners on cross-organizational model exchange and integration, as well as the role of emerging technologies such as AI, remain insufficiently explored [ 11 ] . Based on this motivation, the following research questions are formulated.
paragraphs.zh: 关于在工业环境中引入系统工程方法的实证研究已经识别出持续存在的组织、方法论和工具相关的障碍，这些障碍阻碍了该方法的有效采用 [ 9 ] 。 此外，近期关于协作式MBSE和模型集成的研究通过基于调查的MBSE利益相关者视角分析，以及基于文献和概念的分析取得了进展 [ 10 , 1 ] 。 然而，MBSE从业者对于跨组织模型交换与集成的看法，以及人工智能等新兴技术所扮演的角色，仍然没有得到充分探讨 [ 11 ] 。 基于这一动机，我们提出了以下研究问题。

paragraphs.en: RQ1: How do MBSE stakeholders perceive the severity of various challenge categories in the cross-organizational exchange and integration of SysML-based system models, and how do these perceptions relate to organizational roles and frequency of involvement in system model integration activities?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1：MBSE 利益相关者如何感知跨组织 SysML 系统模型交换与集成过程中各类挑战的严重程度？这些感知又如何与组织角色以及参与系统模型集成活动的频率相关联？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: How do MBSE stakeholders perceive the usefulness of AI-supported integration tasks, and which human-AI collaboration modes do they prefer?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题2：MBSE 利益相关者如何评价人工智能辅助的集成任务的有效性，以及他们更倾向于哪种人机协作模式？

paragraphs.en: To address the above research questions, this study designed and conducted a questionnaire survey targeting MBSE stakeholders, with a focus on model exchange and integration in cross-organizational collaboration scenarios. The survey collected responses from professionals representing different roles, including OEMs, suppliers, tool providers or consultants, and research institutions. Respondents provided their assessments using a five-point Likert scale and complemented their responses with open-ended questions to share practical experiences and expectations.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决上述研究问题，本研究设计并实施了一项针对 MBSE 利益相关者的问卷调查，重点关注跨组织协作场景中的模型交换与集成。 该调查收集了来自不同角色的专业人士的反馈，包括 OEM、供应商、工具提供商或顾问以及研究机构。 受访者使用五点李克特量表提供了他们的评估，并通过开放性问题补充了回答，以分享实际经验和期望。

paragraphs.en: INCOSE Systems Engineering Vision 2035 highlights a shift toward model-centric digital engineering to address increasing system complexity, tight hardware–software integration [ 12 ] . This shift positions models as lifecycle-wide information carriers that can support structured and traceable engineering information exchange across disciplines and organizational boundaries [ 13 ] .
paragraphs.zh: INCOSE《2035年系统工程愿景》强调向以模型为中心的数字工程转型，以应对日益复杂的系统以及硬件与软件的紧密集成 [ 12 ] 。 这种转型将模型定位为贯穿整个生命周期的信息载体，能够支持跨学科和组织边界的结构化、可追溯的工程信息交换 [ 13 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In line with this vision, MBSE should support the early integration of models, facilitate cross-disciplinary collaboration, and improve development efficiency through model reuse [ 14 ] . However, MBSE adoption in many organizations remains limited to local project or product levels, while enterprise-wide or cross-organizational integration is rarely achieved [ 1 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为贯彻这一愿景，MBSE 应支持模型的早期集成，促进跨学科协作，并通过模型复用提高开发效率 [ 14 ] 。 然而，许多组织对 MBSE 的采用仍局限于局部项目或产品层面，而覆盖整个企业或跨组织的集成则鲜有实现 [ 1 ] 。

paragraphs.en: From the perspective of MBSE system model languages, SysML v1 provides a unified means to represent requirements, structure, behavior, and constraints, and has been widely implemented in many modeling tools [ 15 ] . As its application has expanded to multidisciplinary and cross-organizational collaboration scenarios, however, several limitations have become increasingly apparent. On the one hand, SysML v1 is defined as a UML profile, which results in limited semantic precision. This has increased the difficulty of standardized usage and automated analysis [ 16 ] . On the other hand, practical MBSE adoption is often characterized by organization- or project-specific methodologies and profile extensions [ 17 , 1 ] . Differences among collaborating parties in abstraction levels further amplify the challenges of model alignment and reuse [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 从 MBSE 系统模型语言的角度来看，SysML v1 提供了一种统一的方式来表示需求、结构、行为和约束，并且已被广泛应用于许多建模工具中 [ 15 ] 。 然而，随着其应用扩展到多学科和跨组织协作场景，一些局限性也变得越来越明显。 一方面，SysML v1 被定义为一种 UML 配置文件，这导致其语义精确度有限。 这增加了标准化使用和自动化分析的难度 [ 16 ] 。 另一方面，实际的 MBSE 应用通常以组织或项目特定的方法论和配置文件扩展为特征 [ 17 , 1 ] 。 协作各方在抽象层次上的差异进一步加剧了模型对齐和重用的挑战 [ 10 ] 。

paragraphs.en: From an integration perspective, the profile-based nature of SysML v1 fosters variability in interpretation and tool-specific representation, which increases the likelihood of semantic drift when models are exchanged between organizations. This drift typically manifests as naming inconsistencies, mismatched abstraction levels, and diverging structural decompositions, thereby increasing manual reconciliation effort during integration. These recurring dimensions were used as a conceptual basis to structure the integration challenge categories assessed in the present survey.
paragraphs.zh: 从集成角度来看，SysML v1 基于配置的特性导致了解释上的差异性和工具特定的表示方式，从而增加了模型在组织间交换时发生语义漂移的可能性。 这种漂移通常表现为命名不一致、抽象层级不匹配以及结构分解方式的差异，进而增加了集成过程中手动协调的工作量。 这些反复出现的维度被用作概念基础，用于构建本次调查中评估的集成挑战类别。

paragraphs.en: Moreover, although model exchange mechanisms such as XMI formats have been established, existing surveys on model and data exchange indicate that tool-specific XMI implementations and the handling of additional metadata still require complex and context-dependent transformation and maintenance efforts when exchanging models across tools [ 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 此外，尽管已经建立了诸如 XMI 格式之类的模型交换机制，但现有关于模型和数据交换的综述表明，在跨工具交换模型时，特定工具的 XMI 实现以及对额外元数据的处理仍然需要复杂且依赖上下文的转换与维护工作 [ 18 ]。

paragraphs.en: Against this background, SysML v2 introduces a KerML-based semantic foundation that provides precise definitions of elements, relationships, and constraints [ 5 ] . This supports improved consistency checking, model transformation, and formal analysis in comparison to profile-based approaches. This not only creates the basis for cross-tool transformation, configuration management, and cross-company collaboration in data-space-oriented scenarios, but also opens up new possibilities for integrating AI technologies into MBSE environments [ 10 , 19 , 20 ] .

paragraphs.en: In concrete cross-company collaboration scenarios, the OEM typically performs system decomposition and defines subsystem boundaries within its internal SysML models, resulting in black-box specifications that capture functional, structural, and interface aspects. Subsequently, subsystem-relevant model fragments are extracted from the global system model and delivered to suppliers using agreed exchange formats. Based on these specifications, suppliers carry out detailed design and implementation within their own methodologies and tool-chains, producing model-based representations of the subsystem that are then returned to the OEM for integration into the global system model, verification, and iterative refinement. [ 3 , 2 , 21 ]
paragraphs.zh: 在具体的跨公司协作场景中，OEM 通常会在其内部 SysML 模型中执行系统分解并定义子系统的边界，从而生成能够捕捉功能、结构和接口方面的黑盒规范。 随后，从全局系统模型中提取与子系统相关的模型片段，并使用商定的交换格式将其交付给供应商。 基于这些规范，供应商会在自身的方法论和工具链中开展详细设计与实现，生成基于模型的子系统表示，然后将其返回给 OEM，以便集成到全局系统模型中，并进行验证与迭代优化。[ 3 , 2 , 21 ]

paragraphs.en: Around this typical OEM–supplier workflow, both research and industrial practice have identified several classes of structural challenges. The use of a common modeling language alone is insufficient to ensure consistent understanding across organizational boundaries [ 22 ] . Differences in abstraction levels, naming conventions among collaborating organizations can lead to divergent interpretations of the same model [ 23 ] . Furthermore, effective collaboration often requires explicit upfront agreements on modeling methods and interface specifications to achieve system integration [ 24 ] . This OEM–supplier interaction highlights several structurally distinct integration layers such as model element alignment, structural & behavioral consistency, and technical interoperability of exchange formats and tool infrastructures. Each of these layers may introduce independent sources of integration problems.
paragraphs.zh: 围绕这一典型的 OEM–供应商工作流程，研究和工业实践均已识别出几类结构性挑战。 仅使用一种通用建模语言并不足以确保跨越组织边界时实现一致的理解 [ 22 ] 。 合作组织之间在抽象层次和命名规范上的差异，可能导致对同一模型产生不同的解读 [ 23 ] 。 此外，有效协作通常需要事先明确约定建模方法和接口规范，以实现系统集成 [ 24 ] 。 这种 OEM–供应商的互动凸显了几个结构上相互独立的集成层，例如模型元素对齐、结构与行为一致性，以及交换格式和工具基础设施的技术互操作性。 这些集成层中的每一层都可能导致独立的集成问题。

paragraphs.en: In recent years, research has increasingly explored the use of AI technologies, particularly LLMs, to support MBSE activities [ 12 ] . Proposed approaches include LLM-based assistants leveraging domain ontologies or the SysML metamodel to support requirements formulation, modeling guidance, and consistency checking, as well as the integration of LLMs with system models via the SysML v2 API to enable natural-language-driven model querying, modification, and the derivation of modeling elements [ 7 , 25 , 6 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，研究日益关注人工智能技术（尤其是大型语言模型）在支持基于模型的系统工程（MBSE）活动中的应用 [ 12 ] 。 提出的方法包括利用领域本体或 SysML 元模型的大型语言模型辅助工具，用于支持需求制定、建模指导和一致性检查；此外，还通过 SysML v2 API 将大型语言模型与系统模型集成，从而实现由自然语言驱动的对模型的查询和修改，以及建模元素的推导 [ 7 , 25 , 6 ] 。

sents.en: Proposed approaches include LLM-based assistants leveraging domain ontologies or the SysML metamodel to support requirements formulation, modeling guidance, and consistency checking, as well as the integration of LLMs with system models via the SysML v2 API to enable natural-language-driven model querying, modification, and the derivation of modeling elements [ 7 , 25 , 6 ] .

paragraphs.en: In the context of model integration, AI applications can be differentiated into analysis support functions (e.g., model comprehension, semantic comparison, inconsistency detection), generative assistance (e.g., model element generation or transformation), and autonomous integration decisions [ 26 ] . The acceptance of these categories may differ depending on accountability structures and contractual responsibility in cross-organizational engineering settings. This differentiation informed the selection and formulation of the six AI-supported task types evaluated in this study, covering primarily analysis and assistive functions as well as more generative forms of support.
paragraphs.zh: 在模型集成背景下，人工智能应用可分为分析支持功能（例如，模型理解、语义比较、不一致性检测）、生成辅助功能（例如，模型元素生成或转换）以及自主集成决策 [ 26 ]。 在不同组织间的工程环境中，这些类别的接受程度可能会因问责机制和合同责任而有所不同。 这种区分指导了本研究中所评估的六种人工智能支持任务类型的选择与构建，主要涵盖分析功能、辅助功能以及更具生成性的支持形式。

paragraphs.en: While LLMs demonstrate capabilities in generating engineering artifacts, they also exhibit notable limitations, including data quality, semantic deviations, hallucinated content, and a lack of transparency [ 27 , 28 ] . These observations suggest that, within MBSE contexts, AI is more appropriately positioned as a support tool requiring review rather than as a fully autonomous agent [ 29 , 8 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在生成工程成果方面展现出一定能力，但它们也存在显著局限性，包括数据质量、语义偏差、幻觉内容以及缺乏透明度 [ 27 , 28 ] 。 这些观察结果表明，在基于模型的系统工程（MBSE）环境中，人工智能更适合作为需要人工审核的辅助工具，而非完全自主的智能体 [ 29 , 8 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In general, the state of the art highlights the technical diversity of MBSE approaches and modeling practices in cross-company collaboration scenarios, as well as the growing interest in AI-supported assistance. However, how these heterogeneous MBSE methods, tool ecosystems, and modeling practices and emerging capabilities are reflected in practical model exchange and integration remains unclear. To address this gap, an empirical questionnaire-based investigation was conducted to capture current practices and perceptions in SysML-based system model exchange and integration.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，现有研究突出了跨公司协作场景中基于模型的系统工程（MBSE）方法和技术多样性以及建模实践，同时也反映了人们对人工智能辅助支持的日益关注。 然而，这些异构的 MBSE 方法、工具生态系统、建模实践以及新兴能力如何在实际模型交换与集成中体现出来，目前仍不清楚。 为填补这一空白，我们开展了一项基于问卷的经验性研究，旨在了解当前基于 SysML 的系统模型交换与集成的实践和认知。

paragraphs.en: With regard to validity, the questionnaire items were based on the OEM–supplier collaboration processes and model integration issues identified during the state of the art analysis presented in the section II , which supports content validity. sents.en: The results are therefore interpreted in an exploratory manner and are not intended to support statistical inference or causal claims.
sents.zh: 因此，这些结果应以探索性方式解读，并不用于支持统计推断或因果性结论。

paragraphs.en: Responses to open-ended questions were analyzed using a systematic coding procedure based on Mayring’s qualitative content analysis approach [ 31 ] . An initial category framework was derived from the main model integration challenge aspects and AI application types identified in the literature review and applied to a subset of responses through pilot coding. Based on recurring and representative content, additional subcategories were inductively refined. The finalized coding scheme was then applied to all open-ended responses to identify practical challenges, application expectations, and risk concerns that the standardized questionnaire did not fully capture. All qualitative findings are reported in aggregated, anonymized form.
paragraphs.zh: 对开放式问题的回答采用基于 Mayring 定性内容分析方法的系统性编码程序进行分析 [31]。 首先根据文献综述中识别出的主要模型整合挑战方面和人工智能应用类型，构建了一个初步的类别框架，并通过试点编码将其应用于部分回答。 基于重复出现且具有代表性的内容，通过归纳法进一步提炼了额外的子类别。 随后将最终确定的编码方案应用于所有开放式回答，以识别标准化问卷未能完全涵盖的实际挑战、应用期望和风险担忧。 所有定性研究结果均以汇总且匿名化的形式呈现。

paragraphs.en: This section presents the results of the questionnaire survey. Next, it presents findings on the perceived usefulness of AI-supported tasks, differences by engagement frequency and organizational role. Finally, it summarizes themes derived from open-ended responses.

paragraphs.en: The survey collected responses from 29 MBSE stakeholders with diverse organizational and functional backgrounds. In terms of organizational perspective, the sample includes 8 respondents with OEM-level system responsibility, 8 component or subsystem suppliers, 11 tool providers or consultants, and 6 academic researchers with several respondents reporting experience in more than one role.
paragraphs.zh: 该调查收集了来自 29 名 MBSE 利益相关者的反馈，这些利益相关者具有多样化的组织背景和职能背景。 从组织角度来看，样本包括 8 名承担 OEM 级系统责任的受访者、8 名组件或子系统供应商、11 名工具提供商或顾问，以及 6 名学术研究工作者，其中有多位受访者表示曾在不止一个角色中拥有经验。

paragraphs.en: With respect to modeling languages, SysML v1.x is used by the large majority of respondents, while approximately half report experience with SysML v2. In addition, several respondents interact with UML, BPMN, ArchiMate, UAF, Capella, and company-specific modeling languages. A similar diversity is observed for modeling methodologies, including well-known approaches [ 17 ] (e.g., MagicGrid, HarmonySE, OOSEM, ARCADIA, SPES) and company-specific variants.
paragraphs.zh: 在建模语言方面，绝大多数受访者使用 SysML v1.x，而大约一半的受访者表示有使用 SysML v2 的经验。 此外，一些受访者还使用 UML、BPMN、ArchiMate、UAF、Capella 以及公司特定的建模语言。 在建模方法论方面也存在类似的多样性，包括广为人知的方法 [ 17 ]（例如 MagicGrid、HarmonySE、OOSEM、ARCADIA、SPES）以及公司特定的变体。

paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，背景数据显示，该调查捕捉到了来自异质性组织环境的从业者的观点。这些组织环境的特点是角色混合、多语言工具链以及方法论多样化的MBSE实践，为后续对模型集成挑战及AI辅助集成态度的分析提供了适当的背景。

paragraphs.en: Table I summarizes respondents’ ratings of eight categories of challenges (A–H) encountered during cross-organizational SysML model exchange and integration. All items were rated using a five-point Likert scale (1 = Not an issue, 5 = Very significant issue). For each challenge, the median, the proportion of high ratings (scores of 4 or 5), and the mean value are reported.
paragraphs.zh: 表 I 总结了受访者在跨组织 SysML 模型交换与集成过程中遇到的八类挑战（A–H）的评分。 所有项目均使用五点李克特量表进行评分（1 = 不是问题，5 = 非常严重的问题）。 对于每一项挑战，报告了中位数、高分比例（分数为 4 或 5）以及平均值。

paragraphs.en: Table II summarizes respondents’ assessments of the potential usefulness of AI across six model exchange and integration–related tasks derived from challenges in last section. paragraphs.zh: 表 II 总结了受访者对人工智能在六个模型交换与集成相关任务中的潜在有用性的评估，这些任务源自上一部分提到的挑战。 所有任务均使用五点李克特量表（1 = 无用处，5 = 非常有用）进行评估，结果以中位数、高分比例（4 分或 5 分）以及平均分数呈现。

paragraphs.en: Tasks related to model understanding and semantic analysis received the most consistently high ratings. In particular, semantic structure analysis support (F) and identification of semantic conflicts or inconsistencies (C) both show a median rating of 5, with high-rating proportions above 80%. Similarly, tasks associated with model content comprehension (A) and model element mapping suggestions (B) were also rated highly. Both tasks exhibit high-rating proportions above 75%, with mean scores of 4.28 and 4.21. By contrast, generation of integration workflows and guidance (D) and cross-methodology transformation suggestions (E) are still viewed positively but receive lower overall ratings, with medians of 4 and noticeably lower proportions of high ratings.
paragraphs.zh: 与模型理解和语义分析相关的任务获得了最稳定且最高的评分。 特别是，语义结构分析支持（F）和语义冲突或不一致性的识别（C）的评分中位数均为 5，高分比例均超过 80%。 同样，与模型内容理解（A）和模型元素映射建议（B）相关的任务也获得了较高的评分。 这两项任务的高分比例均超过 75%，平均得分分别为 4.28 和 4.21。 相比之下，集成工作流生成与指导（D）以及跨方法论转换建议（E）虽然仍受到积极评价，但整体评分较低，其中位数为 4，高分比例也明显更低。

paragraphs.en: Overall, the results indicate a strong consensus on the potential value of AI for analysis, interpretive, and conflict-detection tasks. However, generative tasks, such as creating integration workflows or cross-methodology transformations are perceived as less beneficial overall, though the assessments remain positive.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，研究结果表明，在分析、解释和冲突检测任务中，人工智能具有巨大潜力，这一观点获得了广泛认同。 然而，生成性任务（例如创建集成工作流程或跨方法学转换）总体上被认为益处较少，尽管相关评估仍然呈积极态势。

paragraphs.en: Regarding acceptable levels of human oversight in AI-assisted tasks, majority of respondents (83%) preferred a semi-automatic mode in which AI provides support with mandatory human verification. A further 17% favored a more conservative setup in which AI is limited to making suggestions, with the primary work remaining manual.
paragraphs.zh: 关于人工智能辅助任务中可接受的人类监督水平，大多数受访者（83%）倾向于半自动模式，即人工智能提供支持，但必须经过人类验证。 另有17%的受访者更倾向于保守的设置，即人工智能仅限于提出建议，主要工作仍需人工完成。

paragraphs.en: Additional Challenges in Model Exchange and Integration
paragraphs.zh: 模型交换与集成中的其他挑战

paragraphs.en: Respondents identified several additional challenges that extend beyond the predefined integration aspects. A prominent aspect concerns tool limitations and interoperability, including restricted access to model data, unstable exchange mechanisms, and practical difficulties with standardized formats.
paragraphs.zh: 受访者指出了若干超出预设集成范畴的额外挑战。 一个突出的问题涉及工具限制和互操作性，包括模型数据访问受限、交换机制不稳定以及标准化格式在实际应用中的困难。

sents.en: Respondents identified several additional challenges that extend beyond the predefined integration aspects.
sents.zh: 受访者指出了若干超出预设集成范畴的额外挑战。

sents.en: A prominent aspect concerns tool limitations and interoperability, including restricted access to model data, unstable exchange mechanisms, and practical difficulties with standardized formats.
sents.zh: 一个突出的问题涉及工具限制和互操作性，包括模型数据访问受限、交换机制不稳定以及标准化格式在实际应用中的困难。

paragraphs.en: A second theme relates to configuration, change, and consistency management, encompassing issues such as tracking changes across model versions, maintaining consistency between models and related lifecycle artifacts, and handling model evolution across iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个主题涉及配置、变更和一致性管理，包括跟踪不同模型版本之间的变更、保持模型与相关生命周期工件之间的一致性，以及处理模型在迭代过程中的演化等问题。

paragraphs.en: Respondents also emphasized process-, organizational-, and governance-related constraints, including late identification of the need for model exchange, insufficient integration of model exchange into information management strategies, and legal or contractual requirements that finally enforce document-based deliverables.
paragraphs.zh: 受访者还强调了与流程、组织及治理相关的限制因素，包括未能及时识别模型交换的需求、模型交换未充分整合到信息管理系统中，以及最终强制要求以文档形式交付成果的法律或合同条款。

paragraphs.en: Finally, several responses pointed to granularity and perspective mismatches, where differences in abstraction levels or disciplinary viewpoints complicate integration, even when shared modeling tools are used.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，有几项回应指出了颗粒度和视角的不匹配问题：即使使用了共同的建模工具，抽象层次或学科观点的差异也会使整合变得复杂。

paragraphs.en: Promising AI Use Cases for Model Integration
paragraphs.zh: 模型集成的潜在人工智能应用案例

paragraphs.en: Regarding AI support, respondents highlighted several classes of promising Use Cases. One recurring theme describes AI-assisted model understanding and analysis, including AI-based copilot functionality, natural-language querying of models, and support for detecting semantic conflicts or inconsistencies.
paragraphs.zh: 关于人工智能支持，受访者指出了几类有前景的使用场景。 一个反复出现的主题是人工智能辅助的模型理解与分析，包括基于人工智能的副驾驶功能、对模型的自然语言查询，以及检测语义冲突或不一致性的支持。

sents.en: Regarding AI support, respondents highlighted several classes of promising Use Cases.
sents.zh: 关于人工智能支持，受访者指出了几类有前景的使用场景。

sents.en: One recurring theme describes AI-assisted model understanding and analysis, including AI-based copilot functionality, natural-language querying of models, and support for detecting semantic conflicts or inconsistencies.
sents.zh: 一个反复出现的主题是人工智能辅助的模型理解与分析，包括基于人工智能的副驾驶功能、对模型的自然语言查询，以及检测语义冲突或不一致性的支持。

paragraphs.en: Another frequently mentioned theme focuses on the automation of repetitive and low-level modeling tasks, such as correcting notation errors, reducing manual interaction effort, and supporting rapid model validity checks in large models.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个经常被提及的主题是重复性和低层次建模任务的自动化，例如纠正符号错误、减少手动交互的努力，以及支持大型模型中的快速模型有效性检查。

paragraphs.en: Respondents also pointed to model generation and transformation support as a promising area, including the transformation of informal or textual inputs into SysML models, automated diagram creation or refactoring, and transformations across methodologies or SysML versions.
paragraphs.zh: 受访者还指出，模型生成和转换支持是一个前景广阔的方向，包括将非正式或文本输入转换为 SysML 模型、自动创建或重构图表，以及在不同方法学或 SysML 版本之间进行转换。

paragraphs.en: A further theme concerns traceability and cross-domain integration, where AI is seen as supporting end-to-end traceability, consistency analysis, and impact assessment across models, requirements, and related lifecycle artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个主题是可追溯性和跨域集成，其中人工智能被视为支持端到端可追溯性、一致性分析以及对模型、需求及相关生命周期工件的影响评估。

paragraphs.en: Additional Comments and Suggestions on AI Assistance
paragraphs.zh: 关于人工智能辅助的补充意见与建议

paragraphs.en: In the final open-ended question, respondents frequently addressed preconditions and risks for AI adoption, emphasizing that AI should not be used to compensate for poor data quality or insufficient modeling discipline, and that fully automated solutions should be approached with caution.
paragraphs.zh: 在最后一个开放式问题中，受访者经常提及人工智能应用的前提条件和风险，强调不应使用人工智能来弥补数据质量差或建模规范不足的问题，并且应对完全自动化的解决方案保持谨慎。

paragraphs.en: Another theme highlights the role of AI in knowledge structuring and representation, including transforming unstructured information into formal representations and enabling more intuitive access to structured knowledge through natural-language interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个主题强调了人工智能在知识结构化与表示中的作用，包括将非结构化信息转化为形式化表示，并通过自然语言交互使结构化知识的获取更加直观。

paragraphs.en: Finally, respondents stressed tool-chain integration and architectural requirements for effective AI assistance, such as the need for standardized API, write-back capabilities into engineering tools, and closer integration of SysML-based MBSE tools with related environments such as ALM, PLM, and Digital Twin platforms.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，受访者强调了实现有效人工智能辅助所需的工具链集成和架构要求，例如需要标准化的 API、向工程工具回写数据的能力，以及将基于 SysML 的 MBSE 工具与 ALM、PLM 和数字孪生平台等相关环境更紧密地集成。

paragraphs.en: This section interprets the survey findings in relation to existing MBSE and AI-assisted Systems Engineering research. While the preceding sections reported the empirical results of the questionnaire, the following discussion relates these observations to prior work and interprets them in the context of the state of the art. It focuses on explaining why certain integration challenges are perceived as particularly prominent, how these perceptions vary across roles and experience levels, and what the findings imply for the design of AI-assisted model integration in SysML-based MBSE contexts.

paragraphs.en: The survey results indicate that SysML-based model integration is experienced as a multi-dimensional alignment challenge spanning semantics, behavior, traceability, and exchange formats, rather than a single technical bottleneck. The consistently high ratings of these aspects suggest that integration challenges emerge across multiple layers of the system model simultaneously.
paragraphs.zh: 调查结果表明，基于 SysML 的模型集成被体验为一种跨越语义、行为、可追溯性和交换格式的多维度对齐挑战，而非单一的技术瓶颈。 这些方面持续获得的高评分表明，集成挑战会同时出现在系统模型的多层结构中。

paragraphs.en: In the responses, issues related to naming and semantics remain particularly prominent. From an interpretative perspective, inconsistent terminology and discipline-specific interpretations may lead to divergent understandings of ostensibly shared model elements, even when SysML is adopted on both sides of OEM and supplier. Structural and abstraction-level mismatches may further compound this problem, as supplier subsystem models often reflect implementation-oriented viewpoints that are difficult to reconcile with OEM-level architectural decompositions. Behavioral misalignment can introduce complexity, especially in iterative integration scenarios, where asynchronous model evolution may result in inconsistencies between expected and realized system behavior. Traceability gaps and format-related issues suggest that integration challenges extend beyond model content to encompass lifecycle information management and exchange infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 在响应中，与命名和语义相关的问题仍然尤为突出。 从解释的角度来看，术语不一致以及学科特定的解读可能导致对看似共享的模型元素产生不同的理解，即使 OEM 和供应商双方都采用了 SysML。 结构和抽象层级的不匹配可能进一步加剧这一问题，因为供应商的子系统模型通常反映了以实施为导向的观点，这些观点很难与 OEM 级别的架构分解相协调。 行为上的不一致可能会引入复杂性，尤其是在迭代集成场景中，异步的模型演化可能导致预期系统行为与实际系统行为之间出现差异。 可追溯性缺口和格式相关的问题表明，集成挑战不仅涉及模型内容，还涵盖了生命周期信息管理和交换基础设施。

sents.en: In the responses, issues related to naming and semantics remain particularly prominent.

paragraphs.en: The analysis of subgroup differences reveals that perceived integration challenges vary with both MBSE stakeholders’ level of engagement in integration activities and their organizational roles, indicating that integration difficulties are shaped by practical exposure and responsibility within the collaboration workflow.

paragraphs.en: With respect to engagement frequency, respondents with lower involvement in cross-organizational tasks tend to rate naming and semantic conflicts as well as traceability issues slightly higher than those with frequent engagement. In contrast, highly engaged respondents consistently assign higher importance to challenges related to behavioral alignment, model format, methodological and profile integration, and metadata consistency. Meanwhile, differences related to structural abstraction and interface integration remain comparatively small across engagement groups. One possible explanation is that occasional integration efforts are particularly exposed to terminology and traceability issues during initial alignment, while frequent integration activities bring cumulative experience with behavioral, format, and metadata-related problems to the foreground.

paragraphs.en: Role-based comparisons indicate that perceived importance of the different challenge aspects varies with organizational responsibilities. OEM respondents assign the highest importance to naming and semantic conflicts, consistent with their system-level responsibility for consolidating models from multiple suppliers and disciplines. Suppliers exhibit a more evenly distributed concern profile, but report particularly high difficulty with structural and abstraction mismatches as well as methodology and profile integration, reflecting the effort required to align implementation-level models with OEM-defined system architectures and methods. Tool providers and consultants are particularly sensitive to traceability gaps and format-related issues, in line with their role in supporting interoperability across heterogeneous tools and maintaining data continuity during model exchange. Researchers display comparatively balanced ratings across aspects, with slightly elevated attention to semantic, behavioral, and traceability issues, which may reflect exploratory modeling contexts and diverse methodological research. Overall, these results suggest that integration support is likely to be more effective when it is role-aware rather than generic—for instance, by prioritizing semantic harmonization for OEMs, methodology alignment for suppliers, and robust traceability and exchange infrastructures for tool providers and consultants.

These results suggest that AI is primarily perceived as a means to enhance engineers’ ability to understand and assess complex, distributed models rather than to replace established integration practices.

This may reflect a cautious stance toward AI interventions that directly influence modeling decisions or methodological alignment, particularly in cross-organizational contexts where responsibility and contractual boundaries are clearly defined.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，涉及自动化生成集成流程或跨方法对齐建议的 AI 应用案例获得的评分更低且更为参差不齐。 这可能反映出对直接干预建模决策或方法对齐的 AI 介入持谨慎态度，尤其是在跨组织环境中，责任与合同边界被明确界定的情况下尤为如此。

paragraphs.en: Preferences regarding human–AI collaboration further clarify this distinction. Most respondents favor human-leading interaction modes, in which AI provides recommendations or partial automation but all outcomes remain subject to mandatory human review. Notably, neither fully manual approaches that exclude AI support nor highly automated modes with minimal human oversight gain support, indicating that MBSE stakeholders seek a balanced integration of AI and human decision while preserving control and responsibility.
paragraphs.zh: 关于人类与人工智能协作的偏好进一步阐明了这一区别。 大多数受访者倾向于由人类主导的互动模式，在这种模式下，人工智能提供建议或部分自动化功能，但所有结果仍需经过强制性的人工审核。 值得注意的是，既完全排除人工智能支持的全手动方式，也几乎没有人类监督的高度自动化模式，都未能获得支持。这表明 MBSE 的利益相关者希望在保持控制权和责任的同时，实现人工智能与人类决策的平衡融合。

paragraphs.en: The open-ended responses suggest that cross-organizational SysML-based system model integration requires coordinated advances in semantics, infrastructure, and tooling. While SysML v2 offers a stronger formal semantic basis, effective collaboration additionally depends on explicit alignment mechanisms.

paragraphs.en: Persistent concerns regarding format gaps and fragile exchanges highlight the need for API-centric, tool-independent integration infrastructures that replace file-based model transfer and enable controlled access to model data. At the same time, the importance of traceability and consistency challenges indicates that integration support must include lifecycle artifacts and version management.
paragraphs.zh: 对格式差异和脆弱交互的持续担忧凸显了构建以 API 为中心、不依赖特定工具的集成基础设施的必要性，这种基础设施能够取代基于文件的模型传输方式，并实现对模型数据的受控访问。 同时，可追溯性和一致性的重要性表明，集成支持必须包含生命周期相关产物和版本管理功能。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the AI-related results point to a clear design boundary: AI is most acceptable as an analysis assistant supporting model understanding, semantic analysis, and traceability, while structurally invasive or generative decisions should remain under human control.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，与人工智能相关的研究结果揭示了一个明确的设计边界：人工智能最适合作为分析助手，用于支持模型理解、语义分析和可追溯性；而具有结构性侵入性或生成性的决策则应始终由人类掌控。

paragraphs.en: This study has several limitations that should be considered when interpreting the results. First, the sample size is relatively small and based on voluntary participation within specific MBSE communities, which may introduce selection bias and limits the extent to which the findings can be generalized. Second, the findings rely on self-reported perceptions measured on ordinal Likert scales, and thus reflect subjective experience rather than objective integration performance. Third, role-based analyses are affected by overlapping role assignments and uneven group sizes, which constrains the strength of comparative conclusions.

paragraphs.en: Future work will focus on developing and evaluating concrete model alignment mechanisms for cross-organizational SysML-based integration, addressing semantic, behavioral, and traceability consistency across heterogeneous tools and abstraction levels. In this context, AI-assisted approaches will be explored as supportive mechanisms—for example, to assist semantic alignment, detect inconsistencies, and maintain traceability—while keeping integration decisions under explicit human control.

paragraphs.en: This paper provides empirical insights into how MBSE stakeholders perceive integration challenges and AI opportunities in SysML-based system model exchange across organizational boundaries. Addressing RQ1, the findings show that integration difficulties arise from semantic, behavioral, traceability, and format-related issues, whose relative importance varies with organizational role and integration experience.
paragraphs.zh: 本文通过实证研究，探讨了 MBSE 利益相关者如何感知跨组织边界的基于 SysML 的系统模型交换中的集成挑战与人工智能机遇。 针对研究问题 1（RQ1），研究结果表明，集成困难源于语义、行为、可追溯性和格式相关的问题，而这些问题的相对重要性会因组织角色和集成经验的不同而有所差异。

paragraphs.en: Regarding the usefulness of AI-supported tasks (RQ2), stakeholders attribute high value to AI support for analysis tasks such as model understanding, semantic conflict detection, and traceability analysis, while expressing more cautious attitudes toward generative transformations and highly automated workflows. Open-text responses further highlight design requirements for future integration solutions, including robust standards and API, semantically enriched data infrastructures, and close integration with lifecycle management and Digital Twin environments.
paragraphs.zh: 关于人工智能辅助任务的实用性（研究问题2），利益相关者认为人工智能在分析任务（如模型理解、语义冲突检测和可追溯性分析）方面具有高度价值，但对生成式转换和高度自动化的工作流程则表现出更为谨慎的态度。 开放文本回答进一步揭示了未来集成解决方案的设计需求，包括稳健的标准与API、语义丰富的数据基础设施，以及与生命周期管理和数字孪生环境的紧密集成。

paragraphs.en: Overall, the paper contributes practitioner-grounded insights to ongoing discussions on SysML v2–based collaboration and AI-assisted Systems Engineering. It supports a view of AI as an embedded, assistive component in MBSE tool-chains that enhances transparency and reduces routine workload under human oversight. The results point toward concrete research directions for building trustworthy, role-sensitive integration support in future MBSE ecosystems.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，本文为围绕基于 SysML v2 的协作和人工智能辅助系统工程的持续讨论提供了以实践者视角出发的见解。 它支持将人工智能视为模型驱动系统工程工具链中嵌入式辅助组件的观点，这种观点能够提升透明度，并在人类监督下减少常规工作量。 研究结果指出了未来模型驱动系统工程生态系统中构建可信且能感知角色需求的集成支持的具体研究方向。
